title: Titanium Steam Heating Coil
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Steam Heating Coil where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Steam heating coil U-bend assembly requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by steam heating coil u-bend assembly and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for steam heating coil application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for steam heating coil performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Steam Heating Coil resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Steam Heating Coil resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for steam heating coil.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Steam Heating Coil orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Steam Heating Coil is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Steam Heating Coil?
faq.a: Each Titanium Steam Heating Coil shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for steam heating coil.
